items.title: One exMormon App to Rule Them All
items.summary: A new Mormon News Roundup video tours the Mormon News Roundup iPhone app, explaining why it was built and how it works.

items.title: Former LDS chapel in Kauai sold for $4.54M
items.summary: An r/exmormon post says a nonprofit that had been leasing the former Hanalei LDS chapel in Kauai has bought it for $4.54 million, the same price the post says it was sold for in 2024, and criticizes the church for not donating the property toward teacher and lifeguard housing.

items.title: Deconstructing Mormonism & Crossing the Bridge - David Ostler Pt. 2 | Ep. 2228
items.summary: In part two of this Mormon Stories conversation, former bishop, stake president and mission president David Ostler, author of Bridges: Ministering to Those Who Question, describes overseeing the church's historic sites in Palmyra and how his research into why people leave the church changed his own views, according to the episode description.

items.title: "Fine Looking Mormons"
items.summary: A By Common Consent post says the author, while researching an article on Mormon immigration in the early twentieth century, came across a source that prompted the post.

items.title: The latest encounter between an LDS apostle and a Catholic pope
items.summary: The Salt Lake Tribune reports that Latter-day Saint apostle Ulisses Soares was among the interfaith leaders who gathered Monday in Buenos Aires, Argentina, and heard Pope Leo XIV's call to safeguard human dignity.

items.title: Black Latter-day Saints still would like an apology, says LDS theologian | Episode 465
items.summary: On this week's Mormon Land, James C. Jones, a second-generation Black Latter-day Saint, discusses the former priesthood/temple ban, his personal encounters with discrimination in the church and his anti-race curriculum, according to The Salt Lake Tribune's episode description.
